title: Roman to Integer
description:
Convert a Roman numeral to an integer. A smaller numeral placed before a larger one is subtracted (`IV` is 4, `CM` is 900).

**Constraints**

- `1 <= s.length <= 15`
- `s` is a valid Roman numeral in `[1, 3999]`
hints: Walk left to right and subtract a value whenever the next one is larger.

editorial.explanation:
The subtractive cases (`IV`, `IX`, `XL`, ...) all share one rule: a numeral smaller than the one
after it is subtracted rather than added.

So walk left to right, look one character ahead, and pick the sign. No special-casing of the six
pairs required. `O(n)` time, `O(1)` space.
